title: HVAC Speed-to-Lead Automation
summary: Captures incoming enquiries, qualifies leads, sends acknowledgements, notifies sales teams, and tracks follow-ups.
challenge: Service contractors can miss valuable enquiries while working on site, causing delayed responses and inconsistent follow-ups.
solution: An automated workflow that captures, qualifies, organises, and routes new enquiries without constant manual monitoring.
contribution: I designed and built this workflow end to end as a portfolio demonstration: the enquiry form in Typeform, the lead records in Airtable, the automation in Zapier, and the acknowledgements and alerts through Gmail and Slack.

title: Beauty Studio Booking and CRM
summary: An integrated booking workflow connecting reservations, availability, Paystack test payments, and customer records.
challenge: When reservations, availability, payments, and customer records sit in separate places, a studio ends up reconciling them by hand and customer details fall out of date.
solution: An integrated booking workflow that connects reservations, availability, Paystack test payments, and customer records in one flow.
contribution: I designed and built this workflow as a portfolio demonstration, connecting Airtable, Zapier, Google Calendar, and Paystack. Payments run in Paystack test mode.

title: Nara SaaS
summary: A mobile-first platform for beauty and wellness businesses to manage bookings, payments, CRM, inventory, and finances.
challenge: Beauty and wellness businesses often run bookings, payments, customer records, inventory, and finances across separate tools, which makes the day-to-day harder to see and manage.
solution: A mobile-first platform that brings bookings, payments, CRM, inventory, and finances into one product.
contribution: I am designing and building Nara across the stack: a Next.js front end, a FastAPI back end, PostgreSQL and Supabase for data, and Paystack for payments.
